top_reviews.title: Great value high quality charger
top_reviews.body: Great value. It’s not super fast charging speed but enough. Need a few hours to charge it full. I have used it during my last family trip. In a typical day, it can ensure two phones to have battery for the whole day even I needed to keep checking my phone for a theme park queueing app. And during lunch time, I could top up my phone wirelessly while charging my partner’s phone by usb cable simultaneously. In the worst case, I can use my iPhone with the charger sticking at the back though it is a bit heavy and with a phone case the magnetic strength would be not enough to hold firm. Overall, it is good enough for my use case as I don’t need exceptionally fast charging. It is not expensive but high build quality.

top_reviews.title: Brilliant bit of kit for the iPhone 13 Pro Max, but you MUST have a MagSafe case
top_reviews.body: My Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)I picked up this UGREEN Nexode 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank because I was sick of carrying cables around in my pockets when my phone started running low. UGREEN usually makes solid gear, and this one definitely feels like a premium bit of tech, though it has one or two quirks you should consider before buying.⚡ Charging & Dual-Device PerformanceI've been using this with my iPhone 13 Pro Max, and the 10,000mAh capacity is the perfect sweet spot. It gives a big phone like the Pro Max plenty of juice without feeling like you're carrying a literal brick.Charging Speeds: The charging time is average—it’s certainly not the fastest charger you’ll ever use, but it gets the job done. I wasn't using a lightning-fast cable for the wired output, so I can't accurately say if a high-spec cable would speed things up, but for standard top-ups, it's fine.Dual Charging: A massive bonus is that it handles dual charging effortlessly. I had my iPhone charging wirelessly on the back while plugging my AirPods in via a cable at the same time. Crucially, doing this didn't seem to slow down the charging rates for either device at all.🧲 The Magnet SituationThe magnet on this thing is absolutely fantastic—but with a strict condition. On my bare iPhone 13 Pro Max, or when using a proper MagSafe-compatible case, it locks on like glue and isn't budging or sliding around. However, my wife tried it with her standard, non-MagSafe case, and it barely held at all. If you don't use a case, or you have a dedicated MagSafe one, you're golden. Otherwise, it will slip right off.👍 The Good StuffMassive capacity: Takes a massive Pro Max from 0 to 100% with power left over.Rock-solid connection: Holds perfectly onto the phone (provided you use a MagSafe case).Flawless dual charging: Juices up a phone wirelessly and AirPods via a cable simultaneously without dropping speed.The Nexode styling feels robust and doesn't scratch up easily in your bag.👎 The DownsidesStrictly requires MagSafe: Absolutely will not grip through standard, non-magnetic phone cases.Average overall speeds: Completely fine for portable use, but don't expect rapid-charge wall plug speeds.📝 The VerdictOverall, it’s a brilliant, reliable companion for travel or long days out if you're an iPhone user. It cuts out the clutter of cables, handles two devices at once like a champ, and the rubberised build quality gives you peace of mind. Just make sure your phone case is actually compatible before buying!
top_reviews.body_html:
My Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

I picked up this UGREEN Nexode 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank because I was sick of carrying cables around in my pockets when my phone started running low. UGREEN usually makes solid gear, and this one definitely feels like a premium bit of tech, though it has one or two quirks you should consider before buying.

⚡ Charging & Dual-Device Performance

I've been using this with my iPhone 13 Pro Max, and the 10,000mAh capacity is the perfect sweet spot. It gives a big phone like the Pro Max plenty of juice without feeling like you're carrying a literal brick.

Charging Speeds: The charging time is average—it’s certainly not the fastest charger you’ll ever use, but it gets the job done. I wasn't using a lightning-fast cable for the wired output, so I can't accurately say if a high-spec cable would speed things up, but for standard top-ups, it's fine.

Dual Charging: A massive bonus is that it handles dual charging effortlessly. I had my iPhone charging wirelessly on the back while plugging my AirPods in via a cable at the same time. Crucially, doing this didn't seem to slow down the charging rates for either device at all.

🧲 The Magnet Situation

The magnet on this thing is absolutely fantastic—but with a strict condition. On my bare iPhone 13 Pro Max, or when using a proper MagSafe-compatible case, it locks on like glue and isn't budging or sliding around. However, my wife tried it with her standard, non-MagSafe case, and it barely held at all. If you don't use a case, or you have a dedicated MagSafe one, you're golden. Otherwise, it will slip right off.

👍 The Good Stuff

Massive capacity: Takes a massive Pro Max from 0 to 100% with power left over.

Rock-solid connection: Holds perfectly onto the phone (provided you use a MagSafe case).

Flawless dual charging: Juices up a phone wirelessly and AirPods via a cable simultaneously without dropping speed.

The Nexode styling feels robust and doesn't scratch up easily in your bag.

👎 The Downsides

Strictly requires MagSafe: Absolutely will not grip through standard, non-magnetic phone cases.

Average overall speeds: Completely fine for portable use, but don't expect rapid-charge wall plug speeds.

📝 The Verdict

Overall, it’s a brilliant, reliable companion for travel or long days out if you're an iPhone user. It cuts out the clutter of cables, handles two devices at once like a champ, and the rubberised build quality gives you peace of mind. Just make sure your phone case is actually compatible before buying!

top_reviews.body_html:
I've been using the UGREEN Nexode Magnetic Wireless Power Bank (10,000mAh) for about a month, and it has been one of the most useful accessories for my phone.

The magnetic attachment is strong and holds securely while I'm walking, commuting, or using my phone. The 10,000mAh capacity easily provides enough power for a full day, and the 20W USB-C fast charging is noticeably quicker than many other power banks I've used.

What I like most is the convenience of wireless charging. I can simply attach it to my iPhone and continue using the phone without dealing with cables. The build quality feels premium, and despite the large battery capacity, it remains compact enough to carry in a bag or jacket pocket.

Pros:

Strong and secure magnetic connection

Reliable 10,000mAh battery capacity

Fast 20W USB-C charging

Convenient wireless charging

Premium build quality

Great for travel and daily use

Cons:

Slightly heavier than smaller 5,000mAh magnetic power banks

Can get a little warm during wireless charging sessions

Overall, after one month of daily use, I'm very satisfied with this power bank. It's dependable, charges quickly, and gives me confidence that I won't run out of battery during the day. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a high-capacity MagSafe-compatible power bank.
